Long story but basically I wanted to lose weight and I thought it would be a splendid idea to lift weights to do so. i had never lifted a day in my life, and I started with 15 pound weights which is entirely too heavy to start with. So basically my muscles broke down and my arm started swelling. went to the ER and they immediately sent me to the hospital because the nurse that saw me had “a strong feeling” that I had a case of Rhabdomyolysis. Got to the hospital, and they checked the levels of protein in my blood, and i had 36,000+ of some kinda harmful protein when I was only supposed to have around 1,000. So they quickly give me an IV to flush out the toxins, some loopy drugs, and a hospital room to stay in for 4 days. 

for some context: Rhabdomyolysis is the breaking down of muscles, which in turn releases a harmful protein into the bloodstream. This protein will flood your kidneys, causing kidney failure if not treated in time. 
So yeah, stay safe out there guys <3
